name: smwgraphics-super-mario-all-stars-super-mario-bros-styled-spiral-mountains
title: Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros. Styled Spiral Mountains
description:
A tileset that uses most of the palettes, but you can use SMW objects.
It's compatible with SMW status bar.
One advantage is that it uses the same tiles from the darker version of the rocky mountains FG, but colored to use the propeer palette.
This didn't use animation, as the note blocks worthlessly used 4 frames and with no palette animation also.
You can use this with a custom HDMA as well.

Credit LinkstormZ for this. I converted it for SMW usage.
